newsitem.title: FINLAND: LAROX PLANS OPTIONS SCHEME FOR MANAGEMENT.
newsitem.headline: LAROX PLANS OPTIONS SCHEME FOR MANAGEMENT.

text.p: Finnish industrial filters maker Larox Oy said in a statement on Monday it would propose to the annual general meeting a 60,000 markka options scheme as an incentive for the company's management.
Each 1,000 markka bond would carry 1,000 warrants and each warrant would entitle holders to subscribe one Larox B share with a nominal value of 10.00 markka.

The interest-free bonds would mature after four years. The warrants would entitle holders to subscribe shares between February 19 and March 4, 2001, that is the two-week period after the planned release of the company's earnings for the year 2000, Larox said.
The subscription price would be the average price of Larox' OTC-listed B share during the five trading days preceding its March 19 annual general meeting, it said.
